%1$s will open in your browser. Cookies are not shared with Firma Mobile: you may need to start signing in again.
The request from %1$s will be sent to the installed official AutoFirma app. Check and confirm the operation there. This option does not mean a local signature has been completed.
No compatible app is installed or the link is invalid. The page remains open; you can return to the menu and open the procedure in the browser.
Only the public certificate will be shared; the private key does not leave the device.
The certificate will only be sent to the exact domain you confirm.
This is a TLS authentication request, not document signing. It may come from a resource on the page.
Unlock or select a certificate. You will then need to confirm sending it to this server.
The certificate does not match the server requirements or is not valid for this access. You can select another.
Android may remember the choice for this server for up to 10 minutes in this browser. Locking the certificate or leaving the browser clears that choice, not the site cookies.
The request has ended or no longer belongs to this page. The operation has not been repeated. Return to the site to start signing in again.
Server that will receive the result: %1$s
Send the selected public certificate. Does not sign documents.
Create a signature over the data in this request and send the result to the indicated server.
Sending once to the intermediary server…
Open and unlock the certificate. You will then need to confirm this operation separately.
The certificate is not valid for this operation. You can select another.
The intermediary server confirmed that it saved the result. Return to the page to check whether the site accepted the operation; this does not confirm that a procedure has been submitted.
Could not confirm the result of sending. It may have reached the server. It will not be repeated automatically; check the status on the page.
Sending did not start. Check the connection and start the operation again from the page.
The server did not confirm storage of the result. It will not be repeated automatically.
The operation was canceled before you confirmed sending. The page may keep waiting until its request is closed.
The request expired or no longer belongs to this page. The operation has not been repeated.
Could not create and verify the result. It has not been sent as a valid signature.
Confirm only if you recognize the operation and its destination. Unlocking the certificate does not mean accepting.

The request is incomplete or contains inconsistent parameters. The certificate has not been used and its server has not been contacted.

The downloaded request requires an operation or parameters that this version does not yet support.
Preparation has stopped. No signature has been authorized.
The request has expired or no longer belongs to this page.
Could not retrieve and validate this request.
The server may have deleted the file when it was read. The download will not be repeated automatically. Return to the page and start a new operation; do not reuse the same request.
Canceling and notifying the server will only attempt to send a cancellation notification. The certificate, document and signature will not be sent.
Sending only the cancellation notification to the server… No certificates, documents or signatures are sent.
Stopping the wait only affects this device. The notification may have reached the server even if no acknowledgment is received. Check the procedure status on the website.
The storage server has acknowledged receipt of the cancellation notification. That acknowledgment does not confirm that the procedure has been withdrawn or canceled. Check its status on the website.
The operation has been canceled only on this device. No notification has been sent to the server.
The storage server did not accept the cancellation notification. Check the procedure status on the website.

It is not known whether the storage server received the cancellation notification. Check the procedure status on the website before repeating the operation. The notification will not be sent again automatically.
You can browse this website. Using the certificate or AutoFirma requires separate confirmation; compatibility with all procedures is not guaranteed.

An attempt will be made to clear data for the displayed site, and the certificate will be locked. The app will indicate if Android does not allow all cookies for that site to be cleared. Signing out on the server is not guaranteed.
Open a public HTTPS address without creating a profile or saving new permissions. Signing and certificate-based access require their own consent.
Certificate locked. Finishing removal of the saved unlock…

Could not load the local document. Consult the documentation in the official project repository.
Compatibility for this operation has not been confirmed in a real-world scenario. Check the result and the portal receipt before repeating it.
Compatibility depends on the portal and the operation. Some features have not been verified in real-world scenarios; always check the result issued by the organization.
